widgets.name: activation_splines
widgets.title: Bending the line: nonlinear activations vs. linear collapse
widgets.hint: Switch activation between Linear, ReLU, GELU, and Tanh · press play to optimize hidden hinges · drag knot handles along the axis
widgets.pitch: Stacking linear units always collapses back into a single straight line. Inserting nonlinear hinges (ReLU, GELU, Tanh) lets hidden units bend locally around developmental curves.
widgets.data_doc: {x: number[], y: number[], xlabel?: string, ylabel?: string}

widgets.name: xor_fold
widgets.title: The XOR problem: folding space so one straight line suffices
widgets.hint: Compare 0 hidden layers (linear) vs. 1 hidden layer · press play to train · scrub Fold morph to watch space crease
widgets.pitch: When class identity depends on an interaction (XOR or concentric rings), one hidden ReLU layer creases and folds the input plane so opposite quadrants land on the same side of a linear readout.

widgets.name: manifold_untangle
widgets.title: Untangling Christmas lights: progressive manifold disentanglement across depth
widgets.hint: Press play or scrub Depth to travel from input layer L0 to L4 · increase Tangle turns to tighten the knot
widgets.pitch: Two intertwined spiral strands cannot be separated by any flat cut in input space. Residual ReLU blocks loosen one loop of the knot per layer until a linear probe reads out 100%.

widgets.name: mlp_backprop
widgets.title: Inside a tabular neural network: forward pass & error backpropagation
widgets.hint: Press play or step to run forward + backward updates · modulate playback speed · adjust predictor sliders to test live inputs
widgets.pitch: Structured predictors flow forward through weighted ReLU connections to produce a prediction, then propagate residual error backward so each weight updates in proportion to its credit.

widgets.name: transfer_hierarchy
widgets.title: Transfer learning: reusing a visual hierarchy instead of starting from noise
widgets.hint: Switch regime between Frozen head, Full finetune, and Train from scratch · vary Labeled sample size N
widgets.pitch: Pretrained backbones arrive with oriented edges, textures, and 3D part detectors intact. Freezing the trunk and fitting a linear head generalizes from small samples where scratch training overfits.

widgets.name: llm_explainer
widgets.title: (GPT-Style) LLMs: from subword tokens to next-token trajectories
widgets.hint: Press play to trace tokens through attention layers · slide Attention head across all 12 heads · drag the 3D sphere or adjust Temperature
widgets.pitch: Words split into subword tokens and integer IDs, map to vectors, route context through causal self-attention, and trace a trajectory on the unit sphere toward the next token.
widgets.data_doc: {cases: {prompt, tokens, ids, candidates, logits, cand_xyz, traj_xyz, attentions}[]}

widgets.name: sae_superposition
widgets.title: Polysemantic neurons vs. monosemantic Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) latents
widgets.hint: Press play to sweep across topics and watch dense neurons mix vs. SAE latents isolate each theme · click any concept spoke or toggle 2 co-active concepts
widgets.pitch: Networks pack more sparse concepts than neurons via superposition, making single neurons polysemantic. A TopK Sparse Autoencoder expands dense activations into monosemantic latents.

widgets.name: relative_reps
widgets.title: Relative representations: linear classification over natural-language anchor queries
widgets.hint: Toggle anchor queries to grow or shrink the spanned region on the sphere · watch the great-circle decision boundary & accuracy update · drag the 3D sphere
widgets.pitch: Projecting CLIP image embeddings onto their cosine similarities with natural-language anchor queries creates a low-dimensional subspace whose linear classifier weights read out over words.
widgets.data_doc: {queries: string[], query_xyz: number[][], img_xyz: number[][], sim: number[][], y: int[], class_names: string[]}

widgets.name: layerwise_readout
widgets.title: Encoding & decoding across network depth: probing a Vision Transformer
widgets.hint: Press play or scrub Layer to move from the patch stem to the final norm · toggle right view between Beauty scatter and Layer RDM
widgets.pitch: Cross-validated RidgeCV encoding on OASIS aesthetics and linear decoding on SimpleShapes across Vision Transformer blocks, paired with held-out scatters and layer RDMs.

widgets.name: trifecta_explorer
widgets.title: Types of deep learning models: sensory diet, architecture, & objective
widgets.hint: Choose which Trifecta factor to vary · inspect the Input, Architecture, & Model-Zoo schematic · press play or drag the 3D hypersphere
widgets.pitch: Compare how supervised, autoencoder, contrastive, and CLIP objectives sculpt the hypersphere alongside convolutional vs. attention schematics and dog/cat sensory diets.
